Evidence ledger · recent receipts
What this console is. A projection of the capability's state — contracts, runtime decision, candidate scorecards, gates, approvals and receipts. What it is not: it does not promote a candidate (the policy gate does), does not decide truth (the model's output is a candidate), and does not expand a boundary (a human signs a HumanApprovalReceipt). Candidates shown here are not active until promoted.
